Context: 11. Posting of husband and wife at the same station

- (1) Where the spouses belong to the same All India Service or two of the Alf India Services, namely, /AS, JPS and IFS (Croup ' A'):  
The spouse will be transferred to the same Cadre by providing for a Cadre transfer of one spouse to the Cadre of the other spouse on the request of the memb.er of service subject to .the member of service .not being posted under this process to bis/her home cadre. Postings within the 'Cadre will, of course, fall within the ,Pur,view of the .State Government.
